name: Mice Tea
source:
Mice Tea is an erotic human to anthro transformation visual novel that's both cute and sexy. 

You'll play the role of Margaret de Campos, a young bookstore clerk who's frustrated with her life and looking for a change. She doesn't know just how much things are going to change for her and her friends and co-workers.

[From [url=https://cinswitch.itch.io/mice-tea]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《老鼠茶》是一部可爱又性感的人类变兽人色情视觉小说。

你将扮演年轻书店店员玛格丽特·德·坎波斯。她对生活感到沮丧，渴望改变，却不知道自己的朋友、同事以及自己即将经历多么巨大的变化。

[来源：[url=https://cinswitch.itch.io/mice-tea]Itch.io[/url]]
